profile.headline: Software Engineer at Walt Disney Animation Studios

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Lighting Tools. Fx Tools. C++, Python, Qt, PyQt, Katana, Houdini Solaris, USD

positions.title: Application Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Programmed with Ruby on Rails in an agile environment to develop online hosting, incident tracking, and QA management tools
• Assisted with support in debugging operations tickets as well as with testing completed tickets in a JIRA tracker
• Worked directly with managers, developers, testers and documentation specialists through all software lifecycle stages

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Volunteer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Used C++ and OpenKinect/OpenNI libraries for XBox360 Kinect Based Human Computer Interaction with large scale displays
• Utilized Kinect data to track movements of a user and recognize gestures to interact with display data

company.name: California Institute for Telecommunications and Information Technology

positions.title: Research and Development Intern: Panasonic
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Used C++ and to develop and test software towards an interactive user interface on a 3D television display
• Collaborated and worked closely with other researchers and software engineers to meet deadlines set by project lead 
• Created mockup 3D models in Autodesk 3DSMax for interface visualization and simulation with OpenSceneGraph

company.name: California Institute for Telecommunications and Information Technology

positions.title: 3D Modeler Intern
positions.description:
• Completed surfacing, modeling, and animation projects to increase knowledge-base and utilization of Autodesk Maya
• Collaborated with project manager, art, and theatre department towards development of models for a video game 
• Scaled hard-copy artifacts and historical blueprint information to create 3D building models for environments

projects.title: Ray Tracer/Renderer
projects.description: Co-developed a ray tracer that used path tracing or photon mapping for global illumination, bounding volume hierarchy optimizations in C++, and environment/texture/bump mapping with depth of field to create photorealistic images in 7 weeks

projects.title: Rockazoid Blaster 3D Game Team Project
projects.description: Collaborated with a team of three to design a 3D “shoot em up” video game concept and to build a workable prototype in two weeks using OpenGL in C++ and GLSL, leading to an A+ on the project
